paper: Gerber, Bergemann et al. 2023, A&A 669, A43 (arXiv 2206.00967)
provenance_caveat: NO DOI, mutable Seafile -> md5-pinned. Re-fetch is reproducible from the urls + md5s below; the .bin.zip archives were deleted after extraction precisely because this record makes them recoverable.
sirius_only: Sirius only. Model atom + aux live at /srv/codex/grids/nlte/gerber_ts/ (OS drive); the .bin lives at /mnt/codex-data/gerber_overflow/ (DATA drive) and is symlinked in. That split is deliberate: RYA-660 was an OS-drive incident, and grid payloads must not grow the root filesystem.
why: THE ANCHOR. Its Engine-A per-line table (Fe_Bergemann_MPIA.csv) carries 332 wavelengths and stops at 6844 A. This atom has 607 LEVELS and 12,635 transitions, so NLTE is no longer wavelength-capped for Fe. Nothing about A(Fe) changes until an explicit decision -- moving the anchor moves every differential abundance in the Codex.
